name: builder gates
why: Six guards were proved by hand on 2026-08-06/07 and the results written up as prose in tools/builder-tests/README.md. Prose decays, and it cannot detect a guard that stops working later. LESSONS.md §5 is explicit that hand mutation is a tooling gap rather than a discipline one: six steps to perform correctly every time, with no feedback when one is skipped. This is that record made executable.

expect: no builder-test suite claims the Studio E2E port

breaks.expect_none_because: --check compares git HEAD against manifest.json, so an edit to the frozen snapshot COPY under tools/engines/v78/ is invisible to it by design. This is the one limitation found when these gates were mutated by hand on 2026-08-06, and it is recorded here as a declared-uncaught break so it cannot be quietly forgotten or mistaken for a gap nobody noticed. The same property is why a green snapshot check does NOT mean the working tree is clean.
